langCard.title: Languages & region
langCard.description: The language you plan in, the languages your guests speak, and the venue’s time zone.
langCard.yoursHelp: You write your website, events and meals in this language. Guests see a translation where you’ve added one.
langCard.guestsEmpty: All households use your language. Guests from abroad? Set the language of each household in Guests (edit household → Language) and they get the website, RSVP page and emails in their language.
langCard.guestsHelp: Each household gets the website, RSVP page and emails in its language. Add translations of your texts in the website editor, on each event and meal, and for the location below.
langCard.timeZoneHelp: Event times are local times at the venue. Guests abroad also see them in their own time.

events.title: Events
events.description: Welcome drinks, ceremony, reception, brunch… Each guest can be invited to some or all.
events.empty: No events yet. Most couples start with a ceremony and a reception.
events.invited: {count, plural, one {# guest invited} other {# guests invited}}
events.deleteText: {count, plural, =0 {No guests are invited to it yet.} one {# guest invitation to this event will be removed too.} other {# guest invitations to this event will be removed too.}}
events.dialogText: These details appear on invitations and your wedding website.
events.name: Name

collab.title: Collaborators
collab.description: Plan together with your partner, family or wedding planner.
collab.ownersOnly: Only owners can invite people or change roles.
collab.removeText: They will lose access to this wedding straight away. You can invite them again later.
collab.inviteText: We’ll create a private link. Send it by email or WhatsApp; it works once and expires in 30 days.
collab.ready: Invite link ready. Send it to them:
collab.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy automatically. Please select the link and copy it.
collab.cancelText: The link sent to {email} will stop working.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.leaveText: Stop collaborating on {name}. You’ll need a new invitation to rejoin.
danger.leaveDialog: You’ll lose access immediately. An owner can invite you again later.
danger.deleteText: Permanently delete {name} and everything in it, for all collaborators.
danger.deleteDialog: All guests, budgets, seating charts and other data for {name} will be permanently deleted for everyone. This can’t be undone.
